_comment: Metro and vernacular regions of United Kingdom: a curated dataset. packbuild.regions turns it into src/placewise/constants/countries/regions.py (python -m packbuild.regions). Fields: id (stable, placewise:region/<slug>), short_name (what a parsed place's `region` holds), name, country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), admin1 (every subdivision the region reaches into, by its ISO 3166-2 suffix), aliases, members (municipality or county ids from the packs, such as census:<GEOID> or statcan:<CSDUID>; empty until verified against the pack data, never guessed), principal_cities (well-known member cities and their admin1, so a parsed city can be placed in the region offline), city_aliases (other names of member cities -> the name placewise prefers) and notes (why the region is drawn as it is).

regions.name: Greater London
regions.notes: The 32 London boroughs and the City of London, England.
